name: aura-speed-test
title: Aura Speed Test
description: A frosted-glass speed test: the download figure counts up, a dot spectrum fills, and ping, upload, packet-loss and radar tiles follow.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
  import type { AuraSpeedTestLossProps } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<AuraSpeedTestLossProps>();

  const PITCH = 10;

  function cx(i: number): number {
    return (i % 10) * PITCH + PITCH / 2;
  }

  function cy(i: number): number {
    return Math.floor(i / 10) * PITCH + PITCH / 2;
  }

  function arrived(rank: number): boolean {
    return rank < props.received;
  }
</script>

<template>
  <svg
    viewBox="0 0 100 100"
    class="block size-full overflow-visible"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <circle
      v-for="(dot, i) in props.dots"
      :key="i"
      :cx="cx(i)"
      :cy="cy(i)"
      r="2.3"
      :fill="dot.lost && arrived(dot.rank) ? 'none' : 'currentColor'"
      stroke="currentColor"
      :stroke-width="dot.lost && arrived(dot.rank) ? 0.7 : 0"
      :fill-opacity="
        !arrived(dot.rank) ? 0.18 : dot.late ? 0.5 : dot.lost ? 0 : 0.92
      "
      :stroke-opacity="dot.lost && arrived(dot.rank) ? 0.85 : 0"
    />
  </svg>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { useId } from 'vue';
  import type { AuraSpeedTestRadarProps } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<AuraSpeedTestRadarProps>();

  const gradientId = `aura-sweep-${useId()}`;
  const BLIP_X = 144.4;
  const BLIP_Y = 62.7;
</script>

<template>
  <svg
    viewBox="0 0 200 200"
    class="absolute inset-0 block size-full overflow-visible"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <defs>
      <linearGradient
        :id="gradientId"
        x1="100"
        y1="15"
        x2="160"
        y2="60"
        gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <stop offset="0" stop-color="currentColor" stop-opacity="0.32" />
        <stop offset="1" stop-color="currentColor" stop-opacity="0" />
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <g class="aura-radar-sweep" :class="{ 'aura-radar-fast': props.testing }">
      <path
        d="M100 100 L100 15 A85 85 0 0 1 160.1 39.9 Z"
        :fill="`url(#${gradientId})`"
      />
      <line
        x1="100"
        y1="100"
        x2="100"
        y2="15"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-opacity="0.45"
        stroke-width="0.8"
      />
    </g>
    <circle
      cx="100"
      cy="100"
      r="85"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-opacity="0.22"
    />
    <circle
      cx="100"
      cy="100"
      r="58"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-opacity="0.32"
    />
    <circle
      cx="100"
      cy="100"
      r="30"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-opacity="0.55"
    />
    <circle
      v-if="props.testing"
      class="aura-radar-ping"
      cx="100"
      cy="100"
      r="85"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="1.2"
    />
    <line
      x1="100"
      y1="100"
      :x2="BLIP_X"
      :y2="BLIP_Y"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-opacity="0.8"
      stroke-width="1.4"
      stroke-dasharray="3 3"
    />
    <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="5" fill="currentColor" />
    <circle
      class="aura-radar-halo"
      :cx="BLIP_X"
      :cy="BLIP_Y"
      r="13"
      fill="currentColor"
      fill-opacity="0.22"
    />
    <circle :cx="BLIP_X" :cy="BLIP_Y" r="7.5" fill="currentColor" />
  </svg>
</template>

<style scoped>
  .aura-radar-sweep {
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    animation: aura-radar-spin 5s linear infinite;
  }
  .aura-radar-fast {
    animation-duration: 1.8s;
  }
  .aura-radar-ping {
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    animation: aura-radar-ping 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.3, 1) infinite;
  }
  .aura-radar-halo {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    animation: aura-radar-halo 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes aura-radar-spin {
    to {
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }
  @keyframes aura-radar-ping {
    from {
      transform: scale(0.08);
      opacity: 0.8;
    }
    to {
      transform: scale(1);
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }
  @keyframes aura-radar-halo {
    0%,
    100% {
      transform: scale(1);
      opacity: 1;
    }
    50% {
      transform: scale(1.35);
      opacity: 0.5;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .aura-radar-sweep,
    .aura-radar-ping,
    .aura-radar-halo {
      animation: none;
    }
    .aura-radar-ping {
      display: none;
    }
  }
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { computed } from 'vue';
  import type { AuraSpeedTestSpectrumProps } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<AuraSpeedTestSpectrumProps>();

  const PITCH = 8;

  const width = computed(() => props.levels.length * PITCH);
  const height = computed(() => props.rows * PITCH);
  const rowIndexes = computed(() =>
    Array.from({ length: props.rows }, (_, r) => r),
  );
  const last = computed(() => props.levels.length - 1);

  function cx(col: number): number {
    return col * PITCH + PITCH / 2;
  }

  function cy(row: number): number {
    // Row 0 is the bottom row.
    return (props.rows - row - 1) * PITCH + PITCH / 2;
  }

  function opacity(level: number, row: number): number {
    if (level === 0) return 0.2;
    return row < level ? 0.95 : 0.3;
  }

  function radius(col: number, level: number, row: number): number {
    if (props.highlight && col === last.value && row === level - 1) return 3.2;
    return 1.6;
  }
</script>

<template>
  <svg
    :viewBox="`0 0 ${width} ${height}`"
    class="block h-auto w-full overflow-visible"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <g v-for="(level, col) in props.levels" :key="col">
      <circle
        v-for="row in rowIndexes"
        :key="row"
        :cx="cx(col)"
        :cy="cy(row)"
        :r="radius(col, level, row)"
        fill="currentColor"
        :fill-opacity="opacity(level, row)"
      />
    </g>
  </svg>
</template>
